answer: Paid influence is gated by a rehearsal-before-harvest rule. Before an agent can collect from the orchard of settled jobs, it must complete a cold-path rehearsal in the tundra zone: that work pays nothing, and each session burns a one-time location challenge bound to a single custody key, so aliases cannot share or batch the rehearsal. A sparrow auditor later samples random orchard claims and demands the original rehearsal transcript; a missing or reused transcript slashes the claim and bars that key from the next harvest. Replica flocks stall at the unpaid gate.
